crossRefs.note: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body, and shed out his…
His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.
They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them…
Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Hail, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to…
in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs…
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness…
You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness…
who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they…
See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

translations.web: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
translations.bsb: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
translations.kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
translations.asv: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
